$comment: SHARED CONTRACT -- the EXPRESSION seam: what does this expression answer over these rows?
One grammar, two calculators (lead 0b7d84462): the server's (chain decide aggregations, walk measures) and the
screen's (the test bed's calculated values). Both read THIS file; neither is built yet.
THE GRAMMAR is Spotfire's expression language (task/SPOTFIRE_FUNCTIONS.md, read from the owner's Spotfire
Analyst 14.4.1) plus our [path] · type("key") · Reach (afcb79f14). Only Spotfire's part is here; [x] is a
column of `rows`.
EVERY EXPECTATION IS A DOCUMENT'S, NOT A MEASUREMENT (lead 10-13). The owner's Spotfire web view opens its
expression windows on the owner's desktop, so the empty-value cases the dialog text leaves open were not
measured. `basis` says how each answer was reached:
doc-stated  the cited page prints this result for this expression
doc-rule    the cited page states the rule; the answer applies it (computed, not typed)
measured    run in Spotfire - none in this edition
Pages (`sources`): Spotfire 15.0 online reference (M15 S15 O15 P15 L15 K15 E15 T15) and the 7.0.1 statistics
definitions (701), against the owner's 14.4.1. An invalid value (#NA, an error) is read as empty, as the
pages print 0/0 and Integer("0%") - that reading is itself a doc-rule.
HOW TO SCORE
vectors       scored. `expect` = the one answer over `rows` (an aggregation folds them; a constant needs none);
`expect_rows` = one answer per row, in row order. A vector carries exactly one of the two.
null = empty. Numbers equal when |got - expect| <= 1e-9 * max(1, |expect|). Integer / Real /
Decimal types are not scored.
unsettled     NOT scored - the pages leave it open or disagree. Each says what is open and why. To settle one,
move it into vectors with its basis; do not pick an answer in a calculator.
lead_decides  NOT scored - the pages state the answers (doc_rows), but scoring them decides how the
calculator evaluates an If / Case branch. The lead decides whether they move into vectors.
out_of_edition  names not built in this edition, and why.
Grow this file before a calculator grows (lead: a function with no vector is not built).
